title: Akbar Shaheed Hogaye Tanha Hue Hussain
body:
Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Barchi se tukde ho gaya Zainab ke dil ka chain, bete ke saath jachuki benai ye Hussain, barpa hai khaima gah mein har simt shoroshain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Pehna ke zindagi mein kafan run ko di sada, thaitul hinak bhi bandh ke laila ne tha kaha, jao sidharo marne ko aye mere nooreain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Qasim hai paas aur na Abbas paas hai, sab dost marchuke hain adu aas pass hai, be aasra hai run mein ab shahe mashraqain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Atthara daag dil pa hai tanha liye huve, har har khadam pa khune tamanna liye huve, jate hain run ko thokrain khate huve Hussain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Laash-e-jawani kaise zaifi uthayegi, Akbar ki laash khaime mein kis tarha aayegi, imdaad kobulate hain bachchao ko ab Hussain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Zakhamao se chur chur hai beta pada huva, barchi jigar mein seenay mein dum hai ruka huva, dum todta hai saamne aankhaon ka nooreain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
Aao Najaf se ya Ali imdad ke liye, maqtal mein pauncho bete ki imdad ke liye, aawaz de rahi hai yeh tanhaeye Hussain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Gurbat mein istarah koi beaasra na ho, duniya mein aaisa koi hasan waqiya na ho, istarah se lute na kisi ke bhi dil ka chain, Akbar shaheed hogaye tanha huve Hussain
